name: Wolf’s Aspect
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 1, druid 1, inquisitor 1, ranger 1, shaman 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, F (a bit of wolf’s hair)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You invest the ferocity of the wolf into your target, granting them a bestial aspect. While under the effects of this spell your target becomes more bestial in appearance. Growing a large jaw, thick fur and gnashing teeth, your type changes to animal and you gain a primary bite attack which deals 1d6 damage. In addition when the affected creature deals damage with the bite attack they may make a free trip attempt without provoking an attack of opportunity.
